Name: EyeTracking
Description: Join the EyeLink recording that belongs to this EEG onto it, via EYE-EEG (Dimigen et al., 2011): the .asc with the recording's own base name is read, its clock is lined up with the EEG's through the triggers both received, and its gaze and pupil signals are added as EYE channels, with the tracker's own saccades, fixations and blinks as events. The synchronisation is checked and refused when it is not good enough, and its quality is recorded for the data-quality report. Continuous data only.
